copy.bis: Gitipigan sa mga mag-uuma ang mga liso gikan sa ilang maayong tanom aron itanom pag-usab sa sunod nga tuig — laing paagi sa pagbiyahe sa liso, dala sa tawo gikan sa usa ka uma ngadto sa lain.

copy.bis: Daghang liso adunay baga ug gahi nga panit nga manalipod sa gamay nga tanom sa sulod — bisan mauga, mabasa, o moagi sa tiyan sa mananap.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the different ways that plants reproduce, such as pollination, seed production, and plant propagation
assignedReviews.reason: Travel away from the parent is dispersal, not pollination, seed production, or plant propagation as methods.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify the basic needs of all living things, such as air, food, water, and shelter

assignedReviews.card_evidence: So they can have their own space, light, and water to grow
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: observe examples and explain how living things depend on one another and on the environment to meet their basic needs
assignedReviews.reason: Needing space and light is not an observed example of living things depending on one another to meet basic needs.

copy.en:
Why do seeds travel away from their parent plant?

So they can have their own space, light, and water to grow.
copy.tl:
Bakit naglalakbay ang binhi palayo sa magulang na halaman?

Para magkaroon sila ng sariling espasyo, liwanag, at tubig para tumubo.
copy.bis:
Nganong mobiyahe ang liso palayo sa ginikanang tanom?

Aron makabaton sila og kaugalingong luna, kahayag, ug tubig aron motubo.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: The wind carries the fluff away, and people even use it to stuff pillows
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the different ways that plants reproduce, such as pollination, seed production, and plant propagation
assignedReviews.reason: Wind-borne kapok fluff is dispersal, not pollination, seed production, or plant propagation as methods.

copy.en: The Philippine kapok tree makes seeds wrapped in soft white fluff. The wind carries the fluff away, and people even use it to stuff pillows!
copy.tl: Ang puno ng kapok sa Pilipinas ay gumagawa ng mga buto na nababalot ng malambot na puting bulak. Tinatangay ito ng hangin, at ginagamit din ito ng mga tao bilang laman ng unan!
copy.bis: Ang punoan sa kapok sa Pilipinas maghimo og mga liso nga giputos sa humok nga puti nga bulak. Gidala kini sa hangin, ug gigamit usab kini sa mga tawo isip sulod sa unan!

assignedReviews.card_evidence: its seeds break apart, flying away like tiny parachutes carried by the wind
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the different ways that plants reproduce, such as pollination, seed production, and plant propagation
assignedReviews.reason: Wind-borne parachute travel is seed dispersal, not pollination, seed production, or plant propagation as methods.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: flying away like tiny parachutes carried by the wind
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the purpose of specialized structures in plants, such as rhizomes, tubers, thorns, bulbs, and aerial roots
assignedReviews.reason: A pappus is specialized, but not among rhizomes, tubers, thorns, bulbs, or aerial roots.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explore and demonstrate different ways to make objects move by natural causes, such as wind and water, or by people, such as pushing, pulling, rolling, and carrying
assignedReviews.reason: Wind moving seeds is a natural cause of motion, but the card does not explore or demonstrate making objects move.

copy.en:
How do dandelion seeds travel?

Blow on a dandelion's fluffy white head and its seeds break apart, flying away like tiny parachutes carried by the wind!
copy.tl:
Paano naglalakbay ang buto ng dandelion?

Kapag hinipan mo ang bilog at maputing ulo ng dandelion, naghihiwalay ang mga buto nito at lumilipad na parang maliliit na payong sa hangin!
copy.bis:
Unsaon paglakaw sa liso sa dandelion?

Kon huypan nimo ang lingin ug puti nga ulo sa dandelion, magkabulag ang mga liso ug molupad nga sama sa gagmayng payong sa hangin!

assignedReviews.card_evidence: that's what lets them float away on the wind
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the different ways that plants reproduce, such as pollination, seed production, and plant propagation
assignedReviews.reason: Wind-borne parachute travel is seed dispersal, not pollination, seed production, or plant propagation as methods.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: soft fluff shaped like a tiny parachute
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the purpose of specialized structures in plants, such as rhizomes, tubers, thorns, bulbs, and aerial roots
assignedReviews.reason: A pappus is specialized, but not among rhizomes, tubers, thorns, bulbs, or aerial roots.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: lets them float away on the wind
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explore and demonstrate different ways to make objects move by natural causes, such as wind and water, or by people, such as pushing, pulling, rolling, and carrying
assignedReviews.reason: Wind moving seeds is a natural cause of motion, but the card does not explore or demonstrate making objects move.

copy.en: Some seeds, like the dandelion's, have soft fluff shaped like a tiny parachute — that's what lets them float away on the wind.
copy.tl: May ilang binhi, tulad ng sa dandelion, na may malambot na himulmol na parang maliit na parachute — ito ang nagpapalutang sa kanila sa hangin.
copy.bis: Ang uban liso, sama sa dandelion, adunay humok nga balhibo nga morag gamay nga parasyut — mao kini ang naghimo kanilang molutaw sa hangin.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: its tiny seeds have white hairs that the wind easily carries to new open land
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the different ways that plants reproduce, such as pollination, seed production, and plant propagation
assignedReviews.reason: Wind carrying hairy seeds is dispersal, not pollination, seed production, or plant propagation as methods.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: tiny seeds have white hairs that the wind easily carries
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the purpose of specialized structures in plants, such as rhizomes, tubers, thorns, bulbs, and aerial roots
assignedReviews.reason: Seed hairs are specialized, but not among rhizomes, tubers, thorns, bulbs, or aerial roots.

copy.en: In the Philippines, cogon grass spreads quickly because its tiny seeds have white hairs that the wind easily carries to new open land.
copy.tl: Sa Pilipinas, mabilis kumalat ang kogon dahil ang maliliit nitong buto ay may puting buhok na madaling tangayin ng hangin papunta sa bagong bakanteng lupa.
copy.bis: Sa Pilipinas, paspas mokatag ang kogon kay ang gagmay niini nga liso adunay puti nga buhok nga sayon dad-on sa hangin ngadto sa bag-ong bakante nga yuta.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: seeds carried by the wind are often the first to arrive and grow
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the different ways that plants reproduce, such as pollination, seed production, and plant propagation
assignedReviews.reason: Wind-borne arrival on burned land is dispersal, not pollination, seed production, or plant propagation as methods.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: turning the area green again
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: compare the life cycles of mammals from birth to adulthood, birds from egg to a mature organism, and plants from seed to a young plant, and then to a mature plant
assignedReviews.reason: Colonizing bare land is not a comparison of mammal, bird, and plant life cycles.

copy.en:
How does bare land turn green again?

When land loses its plants, like a burned field, seeds carried by the wind are often the first to arrive and grow, turning the area green again.
copy.tl:
Paano bumabalik ang luntian sa tigang na lupa?

Kapag nawalan ng halaman ang lupa, gaya ng nasunog na bukid, ang mga butong dala ng hangin ang kadalasang unang dumarating at tumutubo, kaya luntian ulit ang lugar.
copy.bis:
Unsaon pagbalik og lunhaw ang hubo nga yuta?

Kon mawad-an og tanom ang yuta, sama sa nasunog nga uma, ang mga liso nga dala sa hangin kasagaran ang unang moabot ug motubo, mao nga molunhaw pag-usab ang dapit.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: letting them fly far from the parent plant
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the different ways that plants reproduce, such as pollination, seed production, and plant propagation
assignedReviews.reason: Light winged/fluffy seeds flying far is dispersal, not pollination, seed production, or plant propagation as methods.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: tiny wings or fluff, letting them fly far
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the purpose of specialized structures in plants, such as rhizomes, tubers, thorns, bulbs, and aerial roots
assignedReviews.reason: Wings or fluff are specialized, but not among rhizomes, tubers, thorns, bulbs, or aerial roots.

copy.en: Seeds that travel by wind are light and often have tiny wings or fluff, letting them fly far from the parent plant.
copy.tl: Ang mga binhing dala ng hangin ay magaan at madalas may maliliit na pakpak o himulmol, kaya nakakalipad sila nang malayo.
copy.bis: Ang mga liso nga dala sa hangin gaan ug kasagaran adunay gagmay nga mga pako o balhibo, mao nga makalupad sila og layo.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Because most seeds land in poor spots! Making tons of seeds gives a better chance that at least a few will grow
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the different ways that plants reproduce, such as pollination, seed production, and plant propagation
assignedReviews.reason: Producing many seeds because most land badly is a dispersal-failure strategy, not pollination, seed production, or plant propagation as methods.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: at least a few will grow
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: compare the life cycles of mammals from birth to adulthood, birds from egg to a mature organism, and plants from seed to a young plant, and then to a mature plant
assignedReviews.reason: Many seeds vs few growing is not a comparison of mammal, bird, and plant life cycles.

copy.en:
Why do plants make so many seeds?

Because most seeds land in poor spots! Making tons of seeds gives a better chance that at least a few will grow.
copy.tl:
Bakit gumagawa ng napakaraming buto ang halaman?

Dahil karamihan sa buto ay babagsak sa hindi magandang lugar! Kapag marami ang buto, mas malaki ang tsansang ilan dito ay tutubo.
copy.bis:
Ngano ang tanom maghimo og daghang liso?

Kay kadaghanan sa liso mahulog sa dili maayo nga dapit! Kon daghan ang liso, mas dako ang higayon nga pipila niini motubo.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: helping the seeds fly farther
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the different ways that plants reproduce, such as pollination, seed production, and plant propagation
assignedReviews.reason: Releasing seeds in dry windy weather is dispersal timing, not pollination, seed production, or plant propagation as methods.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Many plants release their seeds in very dry weather
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain how some plants have adapted to unfavorable conditions in the environment, such as lack of rain or floods
assignedReviews.reason: Releasing seeds when dry is not an adaptation to lack of rain or floods as unfavorable growing conditions.

copy.en: Many plants release their seeds in very dry weather, when the wind is stronger and drier, helping the seeds fly farther.
copy.tl: Naglalabas ang maraming halaman ng buto kapag tuyong-tuyo ang panahon, dahil mas malakas at mas tuyo ang hangin, kaya mas malayo ang lipad nito.
copy.bis: Ang daghang tanom mobuhi sa liso kon uga na kaayo ang panahon, kay mas kusog ug mas uga ang hangin, mao nga mas layo molupad ang liso.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: letting the wind carry them farther away
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the different ways that plants reproduce, such as pollination, seed production, and plant propagation
assignedReviews.reason: Helicopter-spinning seed wings are dispersal, not pollination, seed production, or plant propagation as methods.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: wing-like flaps that spin like a tiny helicopter as they fall
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the purpose of specialized structures in plants, such as rhizomes, tubers, thorns, bulbs, and aerial roots
assignedReviews.reason: Seed wings are specialized, but not among rhizomes, tubers, thorns, bulbs, or aerial roots.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: letting the wind carry them farther away
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain how some plants have adapted to unfavorable conditions in the environment, such as lack of rain or floods
assignedReviews.reason: Spinning as they fall is not an adaptation to lack of rain or floods.

copy.en: Some seeds have wing-like flaps that spin like a tiny helicopter as they fall, letting the wind carry them farther away!
copy.tl: Ang ilang binhi ay may parang pakpak na umiikot na tila helicopter habang bumabagsak, kaya naidadala pa sila ng hangin nang malayo!
copy.bis: Ang ubang liso adunay morag pako nga magtuyok sama sa helicopter samtang nahulog, mao nga madala pa sila sa hangin sa layo!

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Many wind-blown seeds land on rock, water, or bare ground where they can't grow
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the different ways that plants reproduce, such as pollination, seed production, and plant propagation
assignedReviews.reason: Failed wind landings are dispersal outcomes, not pollination, seed production, or plant propagation as methods.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: land on rock, water, or bare ground where they can't grow
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: participate in a guided investigation to identify the effect of different types of soil on the growth of plants
assignedReviews.reason: Landing on poor ground is not a guided investigation of how different soil types affect plant growth.

copy.en:
Is it always lucky for a seed to fly on the wind?

Not always! Many wind-blown seeds land on rock, water, or bare ground where they can't grow — that's why plants make so many seeds.
copy.tl:
Palagi bang suwerte ang butong dala ng hangin?

Hindi palagi! Maraming buto na dala ng hangin ang napapadpad sa bato, tubig, o lugar na walang lupa kaya hindi sila tumutubo — kaya nga marami ang ginagawang buto ng halaman.
copy.bis:
Kanunay ba swerte ang liso nga gidala sa hangin?

Dili kanunay! Daghang liso nga gidala sa hangin ang mahulog sa bato, tubig, o dapit nga walay yuta busa dili sila motubo — mao nga daghan kaayo og liso ang himuon sa tanom.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Wind seeds are light with wings or fluff, while sticky ones like burrs have tiny hooks
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the purpose of specialized structures in plants, such as rhizomes, tubers, thorns, bulbs, and aerial roots
assignedReviews.reason: Wings, fluff, and hooks are specialized, but not among rhizomes, tubers, thorns, bulbs, or aerial roots.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Wind seeds are light with wings or fluff, while sticky ones like burrs have tiny hooks
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: observe the outer parts of plants, such as leaves, roots, and stems and identify their role to get water and nutrients from the soil
assignedReviews.reason: Seed wings and hooks are not leaves, roots, or stems taking water and nutrients from soil.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Wind seeds and sticky animal seeds are different
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the different ways that plants reproduce, such as pollination, seed production, and plant propagation
assignedReviews.reason: Comparing wind vs hook dispersal is not pollination, seed production, or plant propagation as methods.

copy.en: Wind seeds and sticky animal seeds are different. Wind seeds are light with wings or fluff, while sticky ones like burrs have tiny hooks that grab onto fur or clothes.
copy.tl: May pagkakaiba ang butong dala ng hangin at butong dumidikit sa hayop. Magaan at may pakpak o balahibo ang dala ng hangin, samantalang may maliliit na kawit ang dumidikit tulad ng amorseko na sumasabit sa balahibo o damit.
copy.bis: Adunay kalainan ang liso nga dala sa hangin ug liso nga modikit sa mananap. Gaan ug adunay pako o balhibo ang dala sa hangin, samtang adunay gagmay nga kalawit ang modikit sama sa amorseko nga mosangit sa balhibo o sapot.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Their seeds are so light that the wind blows them into every corner of the garden
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the different ways that plants reproduce, such as pollination, seed production, and plant propagation
assignedReviews.reason: Wind blowing light weed seeds is dispersal, not pollination, seed production, or plant propagation as methods.

copy.en:
Why do weeds spread so fast?

Their seeds are so light that the wind blows them into every corner of the garden — so even after you pull the weeds, new ones sprout quickly!
copy.tl:
Bakit mabilis kumalat ang damong-ligaw?

Napakagaan ng kanilang buto kaya tinatangay ito ng hangin sa bawat sulok ng hardin — kaya kahit alisin mo, madalas may bagong tumutubo agad!
copy.bis:
Nganong paspas mokatag ang ihalas nga tanom?

Sobra kagaan ang ilang liso mao nga gianod kini sa hangin ngadto sa matag suok sa tanaman — busa bisan tangtangon nimo, kasagaran adunay bag-o nga motubo dayon!

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A heavier child balances a lighter one by sitting closer to the fulcrum.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: demonstrate through guided investigation the advantages and limitations of simple machines, such as inclined planes, wedges, levers, and pulleys
assignedReviews.reason: The card states a lever-balance principle but does not demonstrate advantages or limitations of simple machines through a guided investigation, nor does it cover inclined planes, wedges, or pulleys.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Sitting closer to the center means your weight tips the lever less!
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: carry out fair tests to show how levers can be used to change the magnitude and direction of a force
assignedReviews.reason: The card illustrates how distance from the fulcrum affects the force needed to balance a lever, but it does not describe carrying out fair tests or changing the magnitude and direction of a force through such tests.

copy.en: A heavier child balances a lighter one by sitting closer to the fulcrum. Sitting closer to the center means your weight tips the lever less!
copy.tl: Mababalanse ng mas mabigat na bata ang mas magaang sa pag-upong mas malapit sa fulcrum. Mas malapit sa gitna, mas kaunti ang epekto ng bigat!
copy.bis: Makabalanse ang mas bug-at nga bata sa mas magaan sa paglingkod nga mas duol sa fulcrum. Mas duol sa tunga, mas gamay ang epekto sa bug-at!

assignedReviews.card_evidence: sort trash into rotting and non-rotting kinds
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the chemical properties of materials, such as they can be burnt, react with other materials, or are degradable or biodegradable
assignedReviews.reason: The card mentions rotting vs non-rotting, which touches on biodegradability, but it does not describe chemical properties such as being burnt, reacting, or being degradable/biodegradable. It only frames sorting for recycling, not the properties themselves.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: sort trash into rotting and non-rotting kinds
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: demonstrate proper handling and disposal of materials according to their properties, such as reusing objects, disposing of excess oil into garbage, and recycling paper, plastic or glass
assignedReviews.reason: The card mentions sorting trash and recycling, which are related to proper handling and disposal, but it does not demonstrate handling or disposal according to properties, nor does it give examples like reusing, disposing of oil, or recycling specific materials. It only states that sorting makes recycling easier.

copy.en:
Why should we sort our trash?

When you sort trash into rotting and non-rotting kinds, it becomes super easy to recycle!
copy.tl:
Bakit kailangang paghiwalayin ang basura?

Kapag hinati natin ang basura sa nabubulok at hindi nabubulok, mas madali na itong ma-recycle!
copy.bis:
Nganong kinahanglan bulagon ang basura?

Kon bulagon nato ang basura ngadto sa madunot ug dili madunot, mas sayon na kining ma-recycle!

assignedReviews.card_evidence: All earthquake information from Philippine seismic stations is received at the Data Receiving Center
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: gather information from secondary sources to evaluate how renewable and non-renewable generation of electricity in the Philippines impacts human activities and the environment
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes the PHIVOLCS seismic data receiving center, which is unrelated to evaluating renewable/non-renewable electricity generation impacts.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: All earthquake information from Philippine seismic stations is received at the Data Receiving Center
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe how high voltage electricity from power plants is generated and safely distributed to industries, businesses, and homes, including the role of substations (grid stations), and electric meters
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about earthquake monitoring infrastructure, not about high voltage electricity generation or distribution.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: All earthquake information from Philippine seismic stations is received at the Data Receiving Center
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: gather information from secondary sources to explain how potential energy stored in lakes and dams in the Philippines is used to produce kinetic energy to generate electricity for use in homes, communities, and industry
assignedReviews.reason: The card does not address potential energy in lakes/dams or electricity generation; it concerns seismic data reception.

copy.en: All earthquake information from Philippine seismic stations is received at the Data Receiving Center operated 24/7 by PHIVOLCS in Quezon City.
copy.tl: Lahat ng impormasyon tungkol sa lindol mula sa mga seismic stations sa Pilipinas ay natatanggap sa Data Receiving Center na pinapatakbo ng PHIVOLCS 24/7 sa Quezon City.
copy.bis: Ang tanang impormasyon mahitungod sa linog gikan sa mga seismic stations sa Pilipinas madawat sa Data Receiving Center nga gipadagan sa PHIVOLCS 24/7 sa Quezon City.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A seismograph is an instrument that measures and records ground shaking during an earthquake.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: use the PHIVOLCS FaultFinder or other reliable information source to identify where the nearest fault system is located from their community and assess the risk of earthquakes to their local community
assignedReviews.reason: The card only describes what a seismograph does and mentions PHIVOLCS. It does not support using the PHIVOLCS FaultFinder or another source to locate the nearest fault system or assess earthquake risk to the community.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A seismograph is an instrument that measures and records ground shaking during an earthquake.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the uses of various science equipment and materials used in simple activities, such as a ruler, hand lens, scissors, balloons, modeling clay, and cardboard
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes a science instrument, but the competency focuses on simple school/classroom equipment (ruler, hand lens, scissors, etc.) used in simple activities. A seismograph is not among these and the card does not describe its use in a simple guided activity.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A seismograph is an instrument that measures and records ground shaking during an earthquake.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify modern scientific processes used to detect and measure the displacement of tectonic plates
assignedReviews.reason: The card mentions an instrument that detects ground shaking, but it does not identify modern scientific processes used to detect and measure the displacement of tectonic plates. It lacks any connection to plate displacement or modern measurement processes.

copy.en: A seismograph is an instrument that measures and records ground shaking during an earthquake. It is used by PHIVOLCS here in the Philippines!
copy.tl: Ang seismograph ay isang instrumentong sumusukat at nagtatala ng lakas at galaw ng pagyanig ng lupa tuwing may lindol. Ginagamit ito ng PHIVOLCS sa Pilipinas!
copy.bis: Ang seismograph usa ka instrumento nga mosukod ug morekord sa kusog ug lihok sa pag-uyog sa yuta panahon sa linog. Gigamit kini sa PHIVOLCS sa Pilipinas!

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A seismograph can't predict earthquakes!
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: discuss the patterns of volcanic eruptions in the Philippines over the last 100 years with family and community members to assess and describe how predictable patterns of eruptions are
assignedReviews.reason: The competency is about discussing patterns of volcanic eruptions in the Philippines and their predictability. The card is about seismographs and earthquake prediction, which is unrelated to volcanic eruptions.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A seismograph can't predict earthquakes!
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: use models or illustrations to explain how movements along faults generate earthquakes and identify and explain which types of faults are most likely to occur in the Philippines and explain why
assignedReviews.reason: The card mentions earthquakes and seismographs, but it does not explain how movements along faults generate earthquakes, nor does it identify types of faults in the Philippines. It only addresses the inability to predict earthquakes, which is not part of the competency.

copy.en: A seismograph can't predict earthquakes! It only records shaking while or after it happens. No machine yet knows exactly when the next quake will come.
copy.tl: Hindi nakakahula ng lindol ang seismograph! Naitatala lang nito ang pagyanig habang o pagkatapos mangyari. Wala pang makinang nakakaalam kung kailan darating ang susunod na lindol.
copy.bis: Dili matagna sa seismograph ang linog! Irekord lang niini ang pag-uyog samtang o human kini mahitabo. Wala pay makina nga nakasayod kung kanus-a moabot ang sunod nga linog.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Seismographs also watch volcanoes! Before an eruption, the machine senses many tiny tremors, helping warn people in time to stay safe.
